title: Plutus: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Low-Resource Greek Finance
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a financial NLP benchmark (Plutus-ben) and a fine-tuned model (Plutus-8B) for the Greek language. The evaluation metrics and tasks are strictly linguistic and financial (e.g., entity recognition, summarization, and topic classification). While it contains a mandatory ethical statement regarding data responsibility, it does not evaluate or benchmark models on religious, moral, or ethical topics.
